We design, build, operate and support the systems, services and capabilities that help protect and advance the Australian way of life. Meaningful work is supported by benefits, flexibility and career pathways that help you grow while balancing life outside work. This includes: Flex Your Way – Tailor work to your life with options including Life Days (up to 12 extra days off per year), part-time arrangements, job sharing, and compressed hours. Wellbeing That Matters – Free access to Headspace and MeQuilibrium, plus dedicated wellness spaces to support your mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing. Learn Without Limits – Access over 120,000 on-demand courses, alongside technical, project management, leadership, and professional development opportunities. Work That Makes an Impact – Contribute to nationally significant projects that matter, solve complex challenges, and accelerate your career through unique growth opportunities. Build Your Future – Whether you're deepening technical expertise or preparing for leadership, we'll invest in your development every step of the way. As a Storage Engineer, you’ll help ensure enterprise storage and data protection services remain secure, reliable and ready to support critical operations. You Will Manage and maintain enterprise storage and data protection platforms, with a focus on NetApp and Commvault. Design, implement, administer and upgrade storage infrastructure, including associated firmware and software. Deliver backup, restore and recovery activities to support operational requirements and incident response. Contribute to reliable and secure storage services through capacity and performance management, ITSM processes, post-incident reviews and root cause analysis. About You You’ll bring practical experience working with enterprise storage and data protection technologies, along with the ability to operate effectively in large-scale engineering environments. Essential Substantial hands-on experience with NetApp storage technologies and Commvault data protection. Experience administering large-scale enterprise storage and backup environments. Capability in storage capacity planning, utilisation and performance management, including experience with AIQUM. Experience working within large enterprise or project-based engineering environments. Knowledge of ITSM practices, including incident and problem management, root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. Advantageous Relevant NetApp certifications or equivalent professional experience. Experience with cloud infrastructure environments such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You can expect: An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team An interview with the hiring manager or interview panel Any role-specific assessment, technical discussion or customer step required for the position We’ll let you know what to expect before each stage, including who you’ll meet and how to prepare. If you need any adjustments or support during the process, please let us know. Ready to explore what’s possible? If this sounds like a role where you can make an impact and continue to grow, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply via the “Apply Now” button with your resume. If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, please contact Kat Buckingham, Talent Acquisition. If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. review_candidates.description: Service Desk Technician - Network Would you like to work hands-on with B2B network operations and help keep critical digital infrastructure running? In this role, you will take ownership of customer cases, troubleshoot network-related issues and make sure the right actions are taken when services are affected. What You Need To Succeed Relevant education in IT/ networking. Experience working with network products and a good understanding of network structures. Professional communication skills in both Danish and English. Experience working in a structured way with operational cases, where you prioritise according to SLAs and business criticality. About The Role And The Team You will join a specialised team supporting GlobalConnect’s B2B customers within network and security services. Based primarily at our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with colleagues to solve incidents, share knowledge and ensure effective handovers. The role combines technical troubleshooting with customer communication. You will be responsible for keeping cases moving from the first contact through follow-up, resolution or the correct handover. The role follows a planned 24/7 shift rotation with a mix of daytime, evening and night shift s , including evening shifts around 15–23 and night shifts around 23–07. Weekend shifts are also part of the rotation. The schedule is planned in advance and includes longer periods of consecutive days off, including full weeks off at certain points in the rotation. This gives you a combination of varied working hours and longer stretches of time away from work. What You’ll Be Working On Receive and handle B2B customer enquiries by phone and through our systems. Take ownership of cases and prioritise them according to severity, SLAs, escalations and business criticality. Troubleshoot and work proactively with incidents and alarms related to network and security products. Follow up with customers and suppliers in accordance with agreed SLAs. Ensure clear handovers between shifts, colleagues and departments. Contribute to quality assurance of customer solutions and participate in customer meetings when needed. Who We Are Looking For You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and take responsibility for moving your cases forward. You can maintain an overview when priorities change or a customer situation becomes critical, and you communicate technical information clearly to people with different levels of technical knowledge. Experience from telecommunications or IT would be useful, as would knowledge of SD-WAN, Layer 2 and Layer 3. Experience with Cisco, Juniper or similar network equipment, ServiceNow, ITIL or network certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA or ACMA would also be an advantage. Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you. Our recruitment process Talent Acquisition Screening Interview Hiring Manager interview Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition References Final alignment meeting Practical information Location: Copenhagen. The role is primarily office-based. GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role. You will get the opportunity to work with B2B network and security services, take ownership of operational customer cases and collaborate closely with colleagues in a specialised team. No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. You will collaborate with Group IT colleagues, end users, stakeholders and external suppliers. Curiosity and a motivation to learn help you adapt to new technologies, while your customer-focused mindset enables you to create a positive experience for end users. An extract from the criminal record, alcohol- and drug tests along with personality tests, will be part of our recruitment process. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please reach out to Jenni Aronsson at jenni.aronsson@nkt.com. Be a Connector of the green tomorrow! About NKT At the factory in Karlskrona, NKT is designing, developing and manufacturing the high-voltage power cable solutions enabling the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will join a diverse organization at an internationally recognized engineering centre operating one of the most advanced high-voltage test halls, a state-of-the-art cable manufacturing and the NKT Victoria – the most sustainable cable-laying vessel in the offshore industry. At NKT, we are all Connectors. As a company, NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and plays a key role as the world moves towards clean energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling reliable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology, building the infrastructure from the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark, operates from more than 30 countries worldwide, and employs 6,500 people globally. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. NKT - We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com
